authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6251 dākṣiṇa explicitly gives Prakrit dāhiṇa/ḍāhiṇa and eastern dāhin/dāhina right. The selected retroflex-initial Tharu and Oriya dahano forms fit this documented family. Exact survey form dahano is retained.

assignments.Notes: CDIAL 6251 dākṣiṇa explicitly gives Prakrit dāhiṇa/ḍāhiṇa and eastern dāhin/dāhina right. The selected retroflex-initial Tharu and Oriya dahano forms fit this documented family. Exact survey form dahano is retained. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 12732 ślakṣṇa gives Oriya sāna small, youngest and Gujarati nānũ small. Oriya sanõ and Bhili nāno younger brother fit the same small/young adjective, with nominal use in the kinship response retained. Exact survey form sanõ is retained.
